import numpy as np, itertools
def comps_of(I,val):
    H,W=I.shape;seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]==val and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)]; comp=set()
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==val and q not in seen: stack.append(q)
                    return out
                out.append(comp)
    return out

def comps_of(I,val):
    H,W=I.shape;seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]==val and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)];comp=set()
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if(y,x) in seen:continue
                    seen.add((y,x));comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==val and q not in seen: stack.append(q)
                out.append(comp)
    return out

import numpy as np, itertools
def comps_of(I,val):
    H,W=I.shape;seen=set();out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if I[r][c]==val and (r,c) not in seen:
                stack=[(r,c)];comp=set()
                while stack:
                    y,x=stack.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen:continue
                    seen.add((y,x));comp.add((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                        if 0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W and I[q[0]][q[1]]==val and q not in seen: stack.append(q)
                out.append(comp)
    return out

    # extract upper pattern tiles between consecutive band-start rows? Use bands: rows above block grouped by separation >=1 blank
    def bands(rows_list):
        bands=[];cur=[]
        for r in rows_list:
            if cur and r>cur[-1]+1: yield cur; cur=[]
            cur.append(r)
        if cur: yield cur
    ubands=list(bands(rs)); dbands=list(bands(rr))

    # pick representative tile: smallest complete component spanning? Use first band

def comps_of(g,c=2):
    seen=set(); out=[]
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r in range(H):
        for cc in range(W):
            if g[r][cc]==c and (r,cc) not in seen:
                st=[(r,cc)]; seen.add((r,cc)); cells=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cells.append((y,x))
                    for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):

                        if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and g[ny][nx]==c and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                            seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(cells)

def clusters(I,O,block_r0,block_w0,block_w):
    # deviation cells: output != input
    dev=[(r,c) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=O[r][c]]
    # cluster into connected groups
    seen=set(); outs=[]
    for p in dev:
        if p in seen: continue
        stack=[p]; comp=[]
        while stack:
            q=stack.pop()
            if q in seen: continue
            seen.add(q); comp.append(q)
            r,c=q
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    stack.append((r+dr,c+dc))
        outs.append(comp)
    return outs
